queries.name: recovery_scheduler_empty
queries.sql:
WITH retained AS MATERIALIZED (
                SELECT
                    a.link_id,
                    a.sync_generation,
                    a.grant_generation,
                    a.updated_at
                FROM
                    imap_accounts a
                    JOIN email_links l ON l.id = a.link_id
                WHERE
                    a.link_id = ANY (
                        $2
            )
                    AND l.macro_id = a.user_id
                    AND l.provider = 'IMAP'
                    AND l.is_sync_active
                    AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                    AND (
                        (a.state ->> 'needs_reauth') IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
                        OR a.state ->> 'notification_pending' = 'true'
                    )
                    AND a.sync_generation = l.sync_generation
                    AND a.grant_generation = l.grant_generation
                ORDER BY
                    a.updated_at,
                    a.link_id
                LIMIT $1
            ),
            candidates AS (
                SELECT
                    a.link_id,
                    a.sync_generation,
                    a.grant_generation,
                    a.updated_at
                FROM
                    imap_accounts a
                    JOIN email_links l ON l.id = a.link_id
                WHERE
                    NOT (a.link_id = ANY ($2))
                    AND l.macro_id = a.user_id
                    AND l.provider = 'IMAP'
                    AND l.is_sync_active
                    AND NOT l.needs_reauth
                    AND (
                        (a.state ->> 'needs_reauth') IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'
                        OR a.state ->> 'notification_pending' = 'true'
                    )
                    AND a.sync_generation = l.sync_generation
                    AND a.grant_generation = l.grant_generation
                    AND NOT EXISTS (
                        SELECT
                            1
                        FROM
                            imap_account_owners o
                        WHERE
                            o.link_id = a.link_id
                            AND o.lease_until > now())
                ORDER BY
                    a.updated_at,
                    a.link_id
                LIMIT greatest ($1 - (
                        SELECT
                            count(*)
                        FROM retained), 0)
            )
            SELECT
                link_id AS "link_id!",
                sync_generation AS "sync_generation!",
                grant_generation AS "grant_generation!"
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    retained.*,
                    0 AS priority
                FROM
                    retained
                UNION ALL
                SELECT
                    candidates.*,
                    1 AS priority
                FROM
                    candidates) batch
            ORDER BY
                priority,
                updated_at,
                link_id
